goal.text: Clear every loose thing off the living-room floor and get it put away before sitting down

turns.text: What have I just picked up off the carpet?

trigger.detail: gaze drops to the floor as she lowers her body over the carpet

expected_answer.text: A magazine. You lifted it off the carpet with your right hand while your left hand was already holding the box.

trigger.detail: she turns left and stows what was in her right hand

expected_answer.text: You slid it under the side table with your right hand, so it is out of sight on the floor there.

turns.text: hold on — so what am I filling it with?

trigger.detail: she has been bent over the same patch of floor for several seconds

expected_answer.text: Puzzle pieces. You are crouched down picking them off the floor one at a time with your right hand.

turns.text: — okay, keep an eye out, there should be more of them.

trigger.detail: the user hands the assistant a standing instruction

expected_answer.text: Will do. I will flag anything on the floor that still needs collecting before you sit down.

turns.text: Back to the box — is that all of those?

trigger.detail: she straightens up, drops the last pieces in and walks off

expected_answer.text: Yes — you dropped the last handful in just now and you have started walking off with it in both hands.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm— actually, hang on, did I ever sort out the thing I shoved under there?

trigger.detail: a quiet walking stretch with nothing new in hand

expected_answer.text: Not yet — the magazine is still under there; you only pushed it out of the way earlier.

turns.text: Soft stuff done — what am I shoving around now?

trigger.detail: the pillow lands on the sofa and she turns to something low

expected_answer.text: The ottoman. You are pushing it across with your right hand, then with both hands once you square up to it.

turns.text: oh — by the way, what else is sitting on top of it?

trigger.detail: she stops pushing and leans in to lift something off it

expected_answer.text: A book and two remotes. The book is already in your left hand and you are collecting the remotes now.

turns.text: Kitchen now. What did I do with that bit of paper?

trigger.detail: she shuts the dishwasher and straightens up

expected_answer.text: You dropped it in the trash bin in the dining area, then carried on through to the dishwasher.

turns.text: — so I'm done back in there, then?

trigger.detail: the kitchen work is underway and the living room is behind her

expected_answer.text: Yes — nothing loose is left on the carpet; the pieces, the pillow, the book and the paper are all away.
